Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class LoanTimer

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.LoanTimer
public final class LoanTimer extends Object
Checks borrow due dates on a timer, independently of any screen (SRS UC-1.6 special requirements). Every tick it sends a reminder to borrowers whose loan is nearly due and auto-returns loans whose due date has passed. The first tick runs at start-up, so loans that fell due while the app was closed are returned straight away.

The reminder goes out when the loan is within REMINDER_LEAD of its due date, or half-way through for loans shorter than twice that, so a 5-second loan still gets one.
